description:
We are seeking a highly motivated and experienced Director of Nursing (DON) to lead our clinical team at a premier skilled nursing facility in Mediapolis, IA. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity for a dedicated Registered Nurse to oversee all nursing operations, ensuring the highest standards of patient care and regulatory compliance.

This full-time role offers a competitive annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000. We are looking to fill this vital position quickly with a leader who is passionate about making a significant impact on the lives of our residents and fostering a supportive environment for our nursing staff.
requirements: Active Registered Nurse (RN) license in Iowa
Minimum of 2-3 years of experience as a Director of Nursing or Assistant Director of Nursing in a skilled nursing facility
Strong knowledge of state and federal regulations for long-term care
salaryOrBonusInfo: Annual salary range of $85,000 - $95,000, commensurate with experience.

description:
An exceptional opportunity awaits a dedicated Family Medicine Physician in Greenville, SC. This role offers a highly competitive compensation package, including a robust base salary and significant bonus potential, designed to reward your expertise and commitment.

We are seeking talented MDs and DOs with a preference for Family Medicine, though Internal Medicine and Med/Ped candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. Enjoy great benefits, generous paid time off, and a supportive environment within a facility committed to a revamped compensation and raise structure. We are open to candidates requiring travel or relocation.
requirements: Medical Doctor (MD) or Doctor of Osteopathic Medicine (DO) degree
Board Certification/Eligibility in Family Medicine (preferred), Internal Medicine, or Med/Pediatrics
Open to travel or relocation for the position
salaryOrBonusInfo: Compensation includes a non-negotiable base salary of $210,000 per year, with an additional bonus structure up to $50,000. This includes a $25,000 guaranteed bonus and a $25,000 potential bonus, with $9,000 available on payday one upon signing a promissory note. Relocation/Sign-on bonuses are part of the overall bonus structure.
